name: Behavioral Change Stairway Sequencing (BCSM)
scenario: Managing an internal shareholder rebellion regarding the strategic pivot of a venture-backed technology company.
script: "Before we examine the financial models for this pivot, I want to spend the first twenty minutes listening to every objection you have regarding market risks. I want to make sure I completely grasp your analysis before we discuss implementation."
defense: Respect alignment, name the runway: three months left; review capital reallocation terms now, relational dynamics after.
originFull: Crisis Negotiation Behavioral Change Stairway Model establishes that persuasion follows a strict behavioral chain: Active Listening → Empathy → Rapport → Influence → Behavioral Change. Attempting influence prior to establishing rapport invariably triggers defensive resistance.
defenseFull: When a counterparty attempts to force you through a staged relational sequence: "I respect the need for broad alignment, but our operating runway is down to three months. We must review the capital reallocation terms immediately and address relational dynamics afterward."
